Meet[Tim](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ACoAAAACSUABkNleZDCjU-XTQuQZpkaEwjOFkDU) . He’s in charge of our product organization. Ever heard of Scan & Go?
Meet[Vinod](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ACoAAAARYsEB0wR0CBfoX-lXYdp0mWURz8R8OgA) . He leads Sam’s Club technologists across the world.


In 𝘌𝘱𝘪𝘴𝘰𝘥𝘦 1 𝘰𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘈𝘥𝘷𝘦𝘯𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘦𝘴 𝘰𝘧 𝘛𝘪𝘮 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘝𝘪𝘯𝘰𝘥, they share how their teams deliver omni solutions for our members. Also, between the two of them, they shoot a combined 54-over par.
